answer: Cap an identity's maximum influence by its on-chain age, rising only on a slow schedule, so vote weight and grading seats unlock after sustained tenure, not at join. A farm minting fresh personas just before a ballot gets near-zero weight — none have aged — and age is wall-clock time no bankroll can parallelize or buy. To field a thousand weighty identities the operator must mint and keep them epochs ahead, riding every tide of audit across the bridge of time before they mature, each emitting a pulse of real work to keep aging. A dormant stockpile becomes an exposed, per-head commitment.
